page.notes: The word "Sim" at the end of the last line is doubtful; it may be "Si" or "Sin". The word "anaritia" appears to be a printing error for "auaritia"; left as printed. The reading "Aphorismos" is set with a long s in print and is transcribed with a plain s. The catchword "non;" stands at the lower right, below the last line. The running head is set in italic type in print; no italic markup is applied because the running head is not running text.
